stemMd: A cell has ribosomes and a plasma membrane but no membrane-bound nucleus. Which finding would additionally support its identification as a bacterium?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A nucleolus enclosed by a nuclear envelope

options.label: C
options.textMd: Chromosomes undergoing mitosis on a spindle

explanationMd: Peptidoglycan is characteristic of bacterial walls. Ribosomes and membranes alone are shared with other cells, so the wall chemistry supplies the more specific evidence.

distractorRationale.c: Bacteria do not divide by mitosis.
